In that election Pataki’s name appeared on the ballot under the following party lines:

| Party line (as shown on the ballot) |
|--------------------------------------|
| Republican Party (United States)    |
| Conservative Party of New York       |
| Tax Cut Now Party (New York)         |
| Liberal Party of New York           |

These are the official names of the parties listed on the ballot when Pataki was first elected Governor of New York.
